summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, effective June 26, 2026. The conversion was approved by the board and became effective at 3:01 a.m. Eastern Time. Each outstanding share of common stock and Series A Preferred Stock of the Delaware corporation automatically converted into one share of the Nevada corporation on a one-for-one basis. No stockholder action was required, and no exchange of book-entry shares is needed. The reincorporation did not change the company's headquarters, business, management, assets, or liabilities. This is a routine change of domicile and does not constitute a special situation event.
